message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Lint Migrations

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/db/migrations/**'

jobs:
  lint_migrations:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Fetch main branch
        run: git fetch origin main:main
      - name: Find modified migrations
        run: |
          modified_migrations=$(git diff --diff-filter=d --name-only main 'packages/db/migrations/*.do.*.sql')
          echo "$modified_migrations"
          echo "text<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "file_names=$modified_migrations" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        id: modified-migrations
      - uses: sbdchd/squawk-action@v1
        with:
          pattern: ${{ steps.modified-migrations.outputs.file_names }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow has no explicit job timeout, so it relies on the default 360-minute limit. The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is supported by a measured experiment (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) showing that adding timeout-minutes preserved all successful runs (3/3) while reducing median elapsed time (~26.8%). Adding timeout-minutes: 5 to the single lint_migrations job is a minimal, safe change that prevents runaway consumption without removing any step, changing permissions, adding secrets, or introducing new network access. All existing build/lint coverage is preserved.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
